bodyHtml:
💻 MacBook, iMac & Mac Mini Repairs · Logan & Surrounds

Mac Repairs Logan. Usually Cheaper Than The Apple Store.

Cracked MacBook screen, a battery that no longer holds charge, or a Mac that will not start? We repair every Mac, MacBook, MacBook Pro, MacBook Air, iMac, Mac Mini and Mac Studio, and we have been doing it in Logan since 2008. Most jobs come in under what you would pay booking through Apple directly, and you get a straight answer on price before we start.

Fix My Mac
✓ 1-Year Guarantee
✓ OEM-Quality Parts
✓ Board-Level Repairs
✓ Free Phone Quotes
Every Mac Model

We Repair All Mac Models.

MacBook, MacBook Pro, MacBook Air, iMac, Mac Mini, Mac Studio and Mac Pro, right back to older eMac, iBook, PowerBook and Xserve machines. If it has an Apple logo on it, there is a good chance we can fix it. Dropped it and shattered the screen? Spilled a drink and voided the warranty? We handle water damage and screen replacement so you can keep the Mac you already own instead of buying a new one.

Why It Is Worth Repairing

Board-Level Repair, Not Just Replacement.

Plenty of shops only know one fix for a faulty logic board: swap the whole thing for a new one, which is the most expensive outcome for you. Our technicians diagnose down to the component and handle board-level and BGA chip work, so a single failed chip or a bad GPU can often be repaired rather than replaced. That usually means a smaller bill and a faster turnaround.

What We Fix

Trained And Experienced In Mac Hardware.

🖥️

Screen Replacement

Cracked glass, dead pixels or a display that will not light up, replaced properly on MacBook, MacBook Pro, MacBook Air and iMac.

🔧

Logic Board Repair

Component-level and BGA chip diagnosis, not an automatic full-board swap. We repair the fault where the fault actually is.

🔋

Battery Replacement

Swollen or worn-out battery not lasting the day? We fit a fresh one and check the charging circuit while it is open.

💧

Water & Liquid Damage

Spilled coffee, wine or water? Bring it in quickly. We clean, dry and assess the board before corrosion spreads.

💾

Data Recovery

Lost photos, documents or work files from a failing or dead drive? We recover what can be recovered before anything else.

⚡

SSD & Storage Upgrades

Move an older Mac to a fast SSD, or add storage, with your files and system migrated across so it is ready to use.

🧠

RAM Upgrades

More memory on the models that allow it, so a slow Mac keeps up with the way you actually use it.

🖱️

Trackpad & Keyboard

Unresponsive, sticking or double-typing keys and misbehaving trackpads diagnosed and repaired or replaced.

🔩

Hinge Repair

Loose, stiff or broken hinges fixed so the lid sits and closes the way it should. See our hinge repair service.

🔓

Password Recovery

Locked out of your own Mac? We can reset access on most models so you are back in without wiping your data.

🔄

Speed-Up & Tune-Up

A Mac that has slowed to a crawl checked over, cleaned up and tuned so it runs closer to how it did when new.

🧽

Annual Clean

Exterior clean plus a deep clean of the fans, vents and heatsink to keep your Mac cool and quiet.

What Sets Us Apart

Why Bring Your Mac To Us?

  • OEM-quality parts as standard. If you would rather keep the price down with a quality alternative part, we will tell you the difference upfront and let you choose.
  • Repairs often done while you wait. Experienced technicians who troubleshoot carefully, so common jobs can be sorted the same day.
  • One-year guarantee on parts and labour. Every repair is covered for a full year when you bring the device back to us. This does not affect your rights under Australian Consumer Law.
  • Fixing Macs in Logan since 2008. We know these machines inside out, from the Retina era through to Apple Silicon.
  • Free quotes over the phone. Tell us the model and the symptom and we will give you a realistic idea of cost before you come in.
  • Honest advice on repair versus replace. If a Mac is not worth fixing, we will say so rather than sell you a repair you do not need.
Fix My Mac
Related Help

Setup, Backups Or A Windows Machine?

If your Mac works but needs setting up, migrating or backing up rather than repairing, our Apple support page covers iCloud, Time Machine, macOS and moving to a new Mac. Not every device in the house is a Mac either. Our laptop repairs service covers Windows laptops from every major brand, computer repairs covers desktop PCs, and if files went missing along the way we also handle data recovery.

Got A Mac Problem?

Send us the model and what it is doing. We will come back the same day with a price.
